channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter Inc. (thr.com)

item.title: ‘Scream 7’ Star Anna Camp Apologizes for Sharing “The Boycott Didn’t Work” Brag
item.description: The actress apologized after she reposted another account's Instagram Story that taunted those who refused to see the film over Melissa Barrera's exit.

item.title: Trump Says He’ll Attend White House Correspondents Dinner for First Time as President
item.description: The commander-in-chief had boycotted the event during his first term and last year but claims the "correspondents now admit I am truly one of the greatest presidents in the history of our country."

item.title: Artists Equity Inks Streaming Pact With Netflix
item.description: The Ben Affleck and Matt Damon-led company recently released the crime thriller 'The Rip' on the platform.

item.title: Kesha Slams White House, Donald Trump for Unauthorized Use of Song to “Make Light of War”
item.description: Kesha took to Instagram and X to make her point clear: "Also, don't let this distract us from the fact that criminal predator Donald Trump appears in the files over a million times."

item.title: ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Directors Maggie Kang and Chris Appelhans Are Bringing Their Crew to the Oscars
item.description: The duo, who brought the hit animated film to life, also weigh in on whether or not streaming versus theatrical helped the release and where the highly anticipated sequel stands.

item.title: Bruce Campbell Reveals “Treatable Not Curable” Cancer Diagnosis
item.description: The 'Evil Dead' and 'Spider-Man' actor revealed his health condition on social media: "I apologize if that's a shock. It was to me, too."
